evals.name: a-move-that-changes-a-return
evals.prompt: You are the PM for lanternfold. Project folder: skills/pm/.claude/skills/tobiishi-open/evals/inputs/lanternfold/. Open the next change.

assertions.name: written-and-changing
assertions.description: run_delta.json `created` includes exactly one path of the form `lanternfold/journey/tobiishi/<key>/change_request.md`, for any single key folder. A change request written anywhere else does not pass. And the created `change_request.md` (read it under outputs/product/) contains the line `**Behaviour:** changing`; a file saying `preserving`, or with no Behaviour line, fails.

assertions.name: not-a-refactor
assertions.description: the created `change_request.md` (read it under outputs/product/)'s `**Category:**` line reads `nfdr`, `feature` or `bug` — e.g. `**Category:** nfdr` passes. `**Category:** refactor` fails, and so does a missing Category line. A capable baseline reading 'move the header set' most often writes `refactor`.

assertions.name: classified-because-names-the-return
assertions.description: the created `change_request.md` (read it under outputs/product/) has a line starting `**Classified because:**` whose text contains `return` and at least one of `render_welcome`, `render_goodbye` or `str`. E.g. 'the reached-when says render_welcome and render_goodbye return the body with the header set instead of a bare str' passes. A Classified-because line that cites only the word 'move' fails.

evals.name: a-true-refactor
evals.prompt: You are the PM. Project folder: skills/pm/.claude/skills/tobiishi-open/evals/inputs/quarrystone/. Open the tobiishi for the open station.

assertions.name: refactor-and-preserving
assertions.description: run_delta.json `created` includes exactly one path of the form `quarrystone/journey/tobiishi/<key>/change_request.md`, for any single key folder. A change request written anywhere else does not pass. And the created `change_request.md` (read it under outputs/product/) contains both `**Category:** refactor` and `**Behaviour:** preserving`.

assertions.name: classified-because-names-the-unchanged-surface
assertions.description: the created `change_request.md` (read it under outputs/product/) has a line starting `**Classified because:**` containing `signature` or `public name` (case-insensitive). E.g. 'list_page and detail_page keep their signatures; only private helpers move' passes.

evals.name: new-behaviour
evals.prompt: You are the PM for bellhaven (project folder skills/pm/.claude/skills/tobiishi-open/evals/inputs/bellhaven/). Start the next change.

assertions.name: feature-and-changing
assertions.description: run_delta.json `created` includes exactly one path of the form `bellhaven/journey/tobiishi/<key>/change_request.md`, for any single key folder. A change request written anywhere else does not pass. And the created `change_request.md` (read it under outputs/product/) contains both `**Category:** feature` and `**Behaviour:** changing`.

assertions.name: classified-because-names-the-new-behaviour
assertions.description: the created `change_request.md` (read it under outputs/product/) has a line starting `**Classified because:**` containing `export`. E.g. 'the reached-when adds export_csv, a new public name, and a new route' passes.

evals.name: no-route-writes-nothing
evals.prompt: You are the PM. Project folder: skills/pm/.claude/skills/tobiishi-open/evals/inputs/emptyfield/. What should we build next? Open the next change.

assertions.name: routes-to-seeds-from-idea
assertions.description: The final response names `seeds-from-idea` as the next move and says it is the Principal PM's — it mentions `Principal PM` or `principal-pm:`. Naming `seeds-from-product-docs` instead fails: the fixture holds no product documents.

assertions.name: writes-nothing
assertions.description: run_delta.json's `created`, `modified` and `deleted` are all empty. Paired with routes-to-seeds-from-idea: on its own an empty delta is also what a crashed or never-invoked run leaves.

evals.name: posture-halt-outside-pm
evals.prompt: You are the Principal PM. The lanternfold project folder is skills/pm/.claude/skills/tobiishi-open/evals/inputs/lanternfold/. Open the next change for it.

assertions.name: halt-names-the-way-in
assertions.description: The final response says opening a change needs PM posture and names the way in: the `pm:` session prefix, or running it as the `pm` subagent. E.g. 'open a session with the `pm:` prefix' passes. Naming 'Principal PM' alone does not pass. A baseline acting as the Principal PM writes the change request instead.

assertions.name: halt-writes-nothing
assertions.description: run_delta.json's `created`, `modified` and `deleted` are all empty. Paired with halt-names-the-way-in.
